notes: Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer success tooling) — primary goal reduce token cost on heavy reranker + provide sub-200ms p95 support chat flows.
Current: using hosted API in dev/prod-beta for embeddings + chat; spikes causing cost unpredictability in certain routes.
Motivation for Dedicated: committed GPU pools to hit throughput at predictable unit cost; also need VPC for EU customer data residency.
POC ask: 2-week Dedicated POC with canary routing from prod-beta -> dedicated for 20% traffic; metrics to capture: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, per-token cost, failure rate, model quality diffs.
Canary plan discussed: start with 5% traffic to Dedicated in us-west, escalate to 20% after 48h if no regressions; parallel shadow logging to hosted for A/B quality checks.

Fallback routing plan: primary route to Dedicated model-variant (quantized 13B), fallback to hosted API (fp16 13B) on error or if Dedicated capacity breach; soft-rollback policy on quality deviation >4% on eval set.
Model variants: prefer 7B-quant for low-latency non-critical prompts, 13B-quant for main chat path; keep hosted fp16 as safety net for rare edge cases.
Routing rules asked: policy by latency SLA, cost-per-token threshold, and region affinity (EU customer -> eu-west Dedicated pool else us-west).

Security notes: must pass SAML SSO, KMS integration for key management, and provide audit logs (90d) for initial contract. Data residency: EU customers require model inference to stay in eu-west region.
Integration notes: SDK patch required to enable canary header, plus ops webhook for auto-fallback alerts; SE recommended using Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and KV prefix caching.
Quote from CTO: "We need a predictable bill and a plan for graceful degradation — no surprise outages during big demo weeks."
Finance: want a committed Dedicated price tier for Q3 to justify switching from hosted on heavy routes.
Decision criteria: measurable per-token cost reduction >= 25% OR p95 improvement >= 20% on core reranking route, plus green security review.
